"Sprigs", by Brannavan Gnanalingam - It is Saturday afternoon and two boys' schools are locked in battle for college rugby supremacy. Priya - a fifteen year old who barely belongs - watches from the sidelines. Then it is Saturday night and the team is partying. Priya's friends have evaporated and she isn't sure what to do. 2021 Finalist Jann Medlicott Acorn Pize for Fiction Attention Seeking, Book Challenge, Writing Styles, White Man, New Zealand, My Books, Battle, Fiction, This Book
